# sh-input

**Purpose:** Type Default (single line), Text box (multi-line: About me, partner preferences; with counter; semantic states show the border only) or Phone (country code + number). Text entry with label, helper text and states.

**Keywords:** input, text field, text box, textarea, multi-line, form, entry, email, phone

## Types

### Type=Default, State=Default

Empty input with placeholder label. Use for fields awaiting user entry.

### Type=Default, State=Filled

Input with entered value and floating label above.

### Type=Default, State=Typing

Active typing state with focus ring and floating label.

### Type=Default, State=Disabled

Non-interactive disabled state with muted colours.
